svg.title: Raghav Sethi - ID card and dashboard
svg.desc: A lanyard ID card for Raghav Sethi, Software Engineer specializing in AI and systems architecture; UAIS Project Lead; University of Alberta, CS Honours. The card carries the Najdorf career line (ECO B90, Sicilian Najdorf, 1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 Nf6 5.Nc3 a6, game in progress) beside a small chessboard. Beside it, portfolio-sourced metrics: 10 projects, 10 roles, 47 skill nodes, 7 systems, a 6-month UAIS project with 6 workstreams.
